mapper.select: select r.receipt_id, r.plant_cd, r.item_id, r.unit_cd, i.unit_cd as item_unit_cd, i.lot_ctrl_yn, r.lot_id, r.node_id, r.qty, r.occurred_at, r.entry_method, r.recorded_by, r.performed_by, r.reversal_of_id, r.reason, a.default_status, n.use_yn as node_use_yn, coalesce(a.stock_yn, 'Y') as stock_yn, a.loc_usage from prd_receipt r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = r.node_id left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = r.node_id where r.receipt_id = #{id}

select n.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(n.node_id) as path, n.use_yn, coalesce(a.stock_yn, 'Y') as stock_yn, a.loc_usage, a.default_status from mst_equip_hier n left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') order by 3, n.node_id
select lot_ctrl_yn from mst_item where item_id = #{itemId}
select receipt_id from prd_receipt order by receipt_id
select trx_id from inv_trx where client_req_id = #{reqId} and req_seq = 1
select count(*) from prd_receipt r where exists (select 1 from inv_trx t where t.client_req_id = 'PRD_RECEIPT:' || r.receipt_id and t.req_seq = 1)
select count(*) from prd_receipt r where not exists (select 1 from inv_trx t where t.client_req_id = 'PRD_RECEIPT:' || r.receipt_id and t.req_seq = 1)
select exists (select 1 from inv_backfill_run where kind = 'PRD_RECEIPT')

insert into inv_backfill_run (comp_cd, kind, run_by, total, posted, existed, failed, detail) values (hb_current_comp(), 'PRD_RECEIPT', #{by}, #{total}, #{posted}, #{existed}, #{failed}, #{detail}::jsonb) returning run_id
select run_id, run_at, run_by, total, posted, existed, failed, detail::text as detail from inv_backfill_run where kind = 'PRD_RECEIPT' order by run_id desc limit 1
